//: Starter scene set for the render-regression harness. Each scene loads a distinct combination of engine/renderer features so that broad code paths get exercised (and can be run under ASan/UBSan for bug-finding, or diffed pixel-for-pixel between two renderer implementations later). 'binary' only selects which engine executable to use - 'sp' = openjk_sp.x86_64, 'mp' = openjk.x86_64; the renderer .so each loads is whatever capture.py's --renderer flag says (rdsp-vanilla/rd-vanilla by default if omitted - see capture.py's own --renderer help for why that's not actually a safe default to rely on). Requires the user's own legally-owned game assets; this manifest contains no copyrighted content, only map identifiers.

scenes.notes: SP main menu. No map load. Exercises 2D/UI rendering, font rendering, menu shaders - independent of any BSP/world content.
Indoor/outdoor academy courtyard (opening tutorial level). Static architectural geometry, a skeletal (Ghoul2) NPC model, sky portal, basic lighting.
Snow/ice exterior level. Different lighting/fog profile and outdoor terrain geometry from academy1.
Jungle/temple exterior. Vegetation (alpha-tested foliage), large outdoor sky, likely water.
Dark atmospheric Imperial facility. Exercises dynamic/colored lighting, fog, and any rain/atmospheric particle effects distinct from the daylight outdoor levels.
MP renderer coverage (codemp/rd-vanilla is a separate code copy from code/rd-vanilla/SP - needs its own exercising). CTF map, open outdoor + structure geometry.
MP renderer, second/different map for broader MP-side geometry and shader coverage.
